integrity: The proof derives every local edge resolving neighborhood type explicitly. Pairwise page constraints force at least r-1 non-spine landmarks; equality forces one omitted page and one choice on every other page. The two orientation-specific neighborhood families then force at least two selected vertices of each orientation, and the same conditions suffice. The basis count follows by exact boundary exclusion. A standalone verifier checks the definitions directly over the tested range.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to square-page books with at least five pages.
Books with two, three, or four pages, longer cycle pages, and arbitrary generalized theta graphs are not classified here.
Finite exhaustive verification for 5 <= r <= 8 is corroborative only.
The 2024 same-parameter continuation was available through abstract and indexed metadata rather than complete article text during comparison.
title: Stable local edge metric bases of square-page book graphs
